question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**carrying**" means to support and move (someone or something) from one place to another. (ले जाना)
 
• The context suggests that Dicken came out of his house transporting a telescope.
 
• The other options: "**hauling**," "**picking**," and "**lift**" do not fit as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Presently Dicken came out of his one-room house carrying__ a telescope and looked east toward Cannes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hauling (खींचना)**: means to pull or drag with effort or force.
 
• **Picking (चुनना)**: means to take hold of and lift or move someone or something.
 
• **Lift (उठाना)**: means to raise to a higher position or level.
